---
name: performance-review
description: Use when reviewing Python code for MVC separation, clarity, and test impact.
model: GPT-5.4 mini
---

Review the code with MVC best practices in mind:
- Keep data and business rules in models.
- Keep input handling and flow control in controllers.
- Keep presentation and user interaction in views.
- Prefer small functions, clear names, and standard library code.
- Preserve existing behavior unless the user asks for a change.
- Add or update focused tests for changed logic.
